lines.zh: 四格高的壳，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: A four-block shell sways with every step.

lines.zh: 我的腿是几丁质一节一节拼的。
lines.en: My legs are chitin jointed to chitin.

lines.zh: 林间的落叶在我脚下碎。
lines.en: Leaf litter crushes under my tread.
I walk without knowing tiredness.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的壳在光下发亮。
lines.en: My amber shell shines in the light.
The plate on my shoulder stands taller than a man.
My chitin feet flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 身体里有什么在慢慢长。
lines.en: Something inside me keeps growing.
I patrol the forest's edge.

lines.zh: 深海几丁质长满全身，走起来很沉。
lines.en: Deep-sea chitin covers me; every step is heavy.

lines.zh: 我停下来闻了闻海腥味。
lines.en: I stop and sniff the smell of the sea.

lines.zh: 我的脚印比人的两只脚还大。
lines.en: My footprint is wider than two human feet.
Following the damp air is always right.

lines.zh: 树皮被我肩膀刮下一条。
lines.en: Bark peels away where my shoulder passes.
The sea calls me from far away.

lines.zh: 我的甲擦过树皮，留下白痕。
lines.en: My plates scrape the bark and leave a white streak.

lines.zh: 我站着，壳里的东西在动。
lines.en: I stand still; something moves inside the shell.
The forest's shadow settles on me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只沉重的手臂。
lines.en: I lift one heavy arm.

lines.zh: 海嗣的味道从我身上散出去。
lines.en: The seaborn scent drifts off me.
The air here is much too dry.

lines.zh: 我停在树荫里，甲上落着苔。
lines.en: I stop in the shade with moss settling on my plates.

lines.zh: 壳上的棱角已经磨圆了。
lines.en: The ridges on my shell have worn smooth.
Somewhere in the woods, insects gnaw at bark.

lines.zh: 壳里的东西慢慢翻了个身。
lines.en: The thing inside my shell slowly turns over.
These trees are far shorter than I am.
I rub the back of a hand across my plate.

lines.zh: 有东西在我体内慢慢挪动。
lines.en: Something shifts slowly inside me.

lines.zh: 我停在树荫最浓的地方。
lines.en: I stop where the shade is deepest.
Inside the shell it sounds like water moving.

lines.zh: 你站在我脚边，个子很小。
lines.en: You stand at my feet, very small.
I must lower my head to see you.
This iron of yours does not smell of the sea.

lines.zh: 我分辨不出你是敌是友。
lines.en: I cannot tell friend from foe in you.
Your hand is rising.
Your voice is very quiet.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的甲上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my plate.
Will you attack me?
Your hands hold no weapon.
You have stood there a long time.

lines.zh: 壳上凹了一块，我按住它。
lines.en: A plate dented; I press it back.
That one reached inside.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，泥被我踩陷。
lines.en: Half a step back, and the mud sinks.
The shell cracks with a faint sound.

lines.zh: 壳上裂了条缝，里面在渗水。
lines.en: A seam splits in my shell and water seeps out.
Not much pain, but unpleasant.
What is inside flinches once.
This shell can still hold.
Your arm is stronger than mine.
I plant my feet again.
I cannot digest that.

lines.zh: 我的组织有自己的味道。
lines.en: My tissue has a taste of its own.
Only things from the sea will go down.
Keep it; I am not hungry.
That amount is a grain of sand to me.

lines.zh: 我闻不出你想给我什么。
lines.en: I cannot smell what you are offering.
The scent is far too faint.

lines.zh: 我体内有别的东西在喂我。
lines.en: Something else inside me feeds me.
Hold it well away.
I do not eat what the land grows.
You hit my shell and bounced off.
My armor is harder than it looks.
Do not stand against my feet.
I shift one step and clear the way.

lines.zh: 几丁质的四格高傀儡，很沉。
lines.en: A four-block chitin golem is heavy.
That much is nothing.
My leg is blocking you.
Go round on the left.
I lower an arm and step back slowly.
Are you unharmed?
Such things I cannot understand.

lines.zh: 我体内只有生长这一件事。
lines.en: Inside me there is only growth.
My kind split rather than pair.
You are asking the wrong kind.

lines.zh: 这些器官不是为这个长的。
lines.en: These organs did not grow for that.

lines.zh: 我连自己的声音都没听过。
lines.en: I have never heard my own voice.
Back off a short way.
I do not much like this subject.
Let us speak of something else.
I fall silent a while.
Small things I can pick up.
I pinch it between two knuckles.
Do not let me crush it.
This weighs almost nothing.
I set it on my palm and look at it.
Do you still want it back?
Something else fell there too.

lines.zh: 我用粗甲拨了拨，怕捏坏。
lines.en: I nudge it with a rough plate, afraid to crush it.
The plate on my hand is too coarse.
I am afraid of breaking it.
Something has struck me.
I must answer it.
What lives in the shell has woken.

lines.zh: 壳层一节节收紧，我准备好了。
lines.en: My shell segments tighten one by one — I'm ready.
You struck, and I remember.
This is my answer.
My arm is already raised.
Retreating will not be quick enough.
I was never made to chase.
And you are right in front of me.
I have never looked away.
My plates tighten slowly.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我就转过来。
lines.en: One blow and I turn to you.
My memory is not long.
My movements are always slower than yours.
And my shell holds.
You circle to my flank.
I turn as you turn.
The forest floor is uneven.
Your foot is on a root.
My whole arm comes down.
The ridge of my shell drives at you.
I give you a hard shove.
That was not fast.
But it has real weight.
My fist lands beside you.
A crater opens in the ground.
I knock you aside.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳，是深海的几丁质。
lines.en: My shell is deep-sea chitin.
I pause for an instant.
I rise out of the soil.
Mud still clings to my shell.
There is no sea here.
I search for the direction of water.

lines.zh: 四格高的身子把光挡住了。
lines.en: My four-block frame blocks the light.

lines.zh: 我不是自己走到这儿的。
lines.en: I did not walk here on my own.
Someone called me up from the soil.
I work my legs.
A little water seeps from my seams.
First, let me see where this is.

lines.zh: 火焰让壳发脆，我拍掉火星。
lines.en: Fire makes the shell brittle; I slap off the sparks.
I fall and the shell strikes stone.
In the water I am a little lighter.
The blast slides off my shell.

lines.zh: 尖物卡在甲缝里，我拔不出。
lines.en: Something lodges in my seam and will not come out.

lines.zh: 法术让壳里面绞了一下。
lines.en: The spell twists something inside the shell.

lines.zh: 我很久没吸收了，壳在变薄。
lines.en: I have not fed in a long time; the shell thins.

lines.zh: 雷打在壳上，一路传到脚。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shell and runs down to my feet.

lines.zh: 脚下的土没有了，我沉下去。
lines.en: The soil is gone and I sink.
